models.title: WTI & Brent
models.question: Are inventories rebuilding, and how quickly can supply respond?

reference.normal_basis: 2025 same-quarter comparison; five-year seasonal normal unavailable

falsifiers.threshold: At least 29 million barrels/day for two quarters
Above the 2025 seasonal comparison for two quarters
Within 10% of seasonal normal; series currently unavailable

limitations: Quarterly EIA anchors are retained at their native frequency. Monthly historical prices are a separate series.
Post-2027 production, demand, inventory allocation and price coefficients are analyst assumptions.
OECD stocks do not measure world stocks. Cushing, spare capacity and regional distillates remain explicit data gaps.
No cost curve percentiles or claimed forecasting accuracy. A single vintage cannot establish a backtest.

cost_floor.note: Average new-well breakeven, not a spot price floor. Permian 67; large firms 59.

validation.reason: One forecast vintage; out-of-sample price accuracy is not yet established.

scenarios.label: Published outlook → extension
scenarios.assumption_basis: Analyst sensitivities, not calibrated price forecasts. Shale responds after four above-cost quarters; lag is 12 months.

models.title: Copper
models.question: Can a refined surplus coexist with scarce concentrate?

treatment_charge.note: Zero contract-TC report in proposal requires a dated primary-source confirmation before becoming an observation.

falsifiers.threshold: Positive treatment charges sustained for two quarters; verified time series required
COMEX build reverses while SHFE stocks rise
Two updates show a deficit instead of the published surplus

limitations: Published refined totals differ by 1kt from the rounded 2026 balance; residual is visible.
Concentrate supply, SX-EW and smelter intake are not interchangeable. Missing split prevents a numerical concentrate balance.
COMEX, LME and SHFE are separate locations; incomplete stock levels cannot produce days of cover.
Copper monthly reference figures are reviewed proposal transcriptions, separate from the verified forecast PDF. No price is inferred mechanically from a surplus.

cost_floor.note: No public project incentive-price estimate selected; no invented mine-cost percentile.

validation.reason: Dated concentrate supply and smelter intake required; no invented concentrate deficit.

scenarios.label: Refined surplus dominates
scenarios.assumption_basis: Prices are analyst paths; disruption applies to refined output once, and price-induced scrap is incremental. No AI demand term is added to ICSG usage.

scenarios.label: Concentrate scarcity persists
scenarios.assumption_basis: Prices are analyst paths; disruption applies to refined output once, and price-induced scrap is incremental. No AI demand term is added to ICSG usage.

scenarios.label: Unreported Chinese absorption
scenarios.assumption_basis: Prices are analyst paths; disruption applies to refined output once, and price-induced scrap is incremental. No AI demand term is added to ICSG usage.

treatment_charge.note: Zero contract-TC report in proposal requires a dated primary-source confirmation before becoming an observation.

concentrate.note: Total mined copper includes SX-EW. A concentrate balance cannot be inferred by subtracting total refined use from mine supply.

models.title: Gold
models.question: Who wants to hold the existing stock of gold?

falsifiers.threshold: ETF outflows persist for two quarters
Higher prices fail to lift recycling or reduce jewellery volumes

limitations: Recycling changes owners; only mined metal grows above-ground stock.
Scenario coefficients are assumptions, not a fitted structural price equation. The real-yield residual is diagnostic only.
No stock-to-flow or Bitcoin power law. Full monetary demand is not observable.
First stock projection covers 1.5 years from the end-Q2 2026 anchor; annual mine flow is approximated at the 2027 scenario rate.

cost_floor.note: Mine costs can constrain supply; no consistent miner AISC panel is attached.

scenarios.label: Official buying holds
scenarios.assumption_basis: Uncalibrated real-rate, dollar and official-demand sensitivities around Q2 2026 bullion. ETF flows are context; no causal price premium is claimed.

scenarios.label: Real rates matter again
scenarios.assumption_basis: Uncalibrated real-rate, dollar and official-demand sensitivities around Q2 2026 bullion. ETF flows are context; no causal price premium is claimed.

scenarios.label: Recycling and demand response
scenarios.assumption_basis: Uncalibrated real-rate, dollar and official-demand sensitivities around Q2 2026 bullion. ETF flows are context; no causal price premium is claimed.

residual_diagnostic.reason: At least 60 aligned monthly bullion, real-yield and broad-dollar observations required. Futures and ETF history are not substituted.

models.title: Silver
models.question: How much metal remains after fabrication and investment demand?

falsifiers.threshold: Lease stress fades and available stocks recover; lease series missing

limitations: The 2026 forecast is annual, not a fabricated monthly time series.
ETP absorption is shown once below the physical balance. Unknown available inventory prevents an exhaustion date.
Copper-related byproduct supply is not added twice. Gold scenarios are inherited and identified.
Primary AISC is not a hard market floor; most silver supply is a byproduct.

cost_floor.note: Primary-mine AISC in 2025. Byproduct mines follow their primary-metal economics.

scenarios.label: Physical base case
scenarios.assumption_basis: Solar paths, gold/silver ratios, growth and ETF flows are explicit analyst assumptions after the 2026 published outlook. The ratio is not a mean-reversion promise.

scenarios.label: Faster solar thrifting
scenarios.assumption_basis: Solar paths, gold/silver ratios, growth and ETF flows are explicit analyst assumptions after the 2026 published outlook. The ratio is not a mean-reversion promise.

scenarios.label: Investment absorption
scenarios.assumption_basis: Solar paths, gold/silver ratios, growth and ETF flows are explicit analyst assumptions after the 2026 published outlook. The ratio is not a mean-reversion promise.

byproduct_bridge.note: Copper-linked disruption is a cross-check only; the byproduct path already accounts for its own growth assumption.

bridges.reason: Silver price reads the named gold scenario and an explicit assumed ratio.
Byproduct sensitivity is already represented in silver assumptions; no additive supply term.
Operating-cost context only; no duplicate physical demand.
